title: GET /v1/sessions
description: Every agent session Herdr knows about on one machine. status, last_message and tail are always there; summary is null while summaries are off, unless the agent wrote its own report. The same data is streamed on /v1/events and kept in sessions.json.

host.description: The machine's name, so a client reading several machines can tell them apart.

workspaces.description: Herdr workspaces that hold at least one agent, in Herdr's order.

session_ids.description: Session ids, in Herdr's pane order.

id.description: Stable while the session lives, even when its pane moves: <agent>:<the agent's session id>, or terminal:<terminal id> when Herdr reports no agent session.

pane_id.description: Where the session is now, e.g. w1:p2. Changes when the pane moves to another workspace. Use it to open the pane in another app.

label.description: The name the user gave the pane, if any.

agent.description: Herdr's agent kind: claude, codex, opencode, kimi, cursor, …

status.description: Herdr's live state for the agent. blocked: stopped at an approval or question.

tail.description: The last lines of the pane's screen.

last_message.description: The agent's last words, read from its own record; null when there is none we can read.

summarizing.description: A new summary is being made right now.

goal.description: What the whole session is trying to get done.

now.description: What it is doing or waiting for right now.

needs_you.description: Open decisions, approvals or actions for the user.

source.description: Where goal, done and todo come from. transcript: the session's own record; screen: the last screens of the pane; self-report: there is no summary yet, only the agent's own report.

summarized_by.description: Who wrote it: the agent kind for a self-report, else the summarizer and model, e.g. claude-code:haiku, opencode:opencode/claude-haiku-5-5, openai-compatible:<model>, command.

self_report_at.description: When set, now / needs_you / blocked / doing come from the agent's own report made at this time; the other fields come from source.

error.description: The last attempt to update failed; the fields above are the previous summary.

id.description: The same thing keeps its id across summaries, even reworded or moved to another list.
